lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਤਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nidh sidh charan gahe taa kehaa kaaRaa ||
lines.translation: Grasping the Lord's Feet, the treasure of the Siddhas, what suffering can I feel?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh vas jisai so prabhoo asaaRaa ||
lines.translation: Everything is in His Power - He is my God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahi bhujaa leene naam deene kar dhaar masatak raakhiaa ||
lines.translation: Holding me by the arm, He blesses me with His Name; placing His Hand upon my forehead, He saves me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar nah viaapai amiu har ras chaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: The world-ocean does not trouble me, for I have drunk the sublime elixir of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਣੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਅਖਾੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)ge naam ra(n)ge ran jeet vadaa akhaaRaa ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am victorious on the great battlefield of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਮਿ ਨ ਉਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee bahuR jam na upaaRaa ||4||3||12||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master; the Messenger of Death shall not destroy me again. ||4||3||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਕਮਾਇਅੜੋ ਸੋ ਆਇਓ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: din raat kamaaiaRo so aaio maathai ||
lines.translation: Those actions you perform, day and night, are recorded upon your forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਲੁਕਾਇਦੜੋ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੀ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis paas lukaaidaRo so vekhee saathai ||
lines.translation: And the One, from whom you hide these actions - He sees them, and is always with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਇ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g dekhai karanahaaraa kaai paap kamaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord is with you; He sees you, so why commit sins?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukrit keejai naam leejai narak mool na jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: So perform good deeds, and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall never have to go to hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar har naam simarahu chalai terai saathe ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the Lord's Name in meditation; it alone shall go along with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhaj saadhasa(n)gat sadaa naanak mitahi dokh kamaate ||1||
lines.translation: So vibrate continually in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and the sins you committed shall be erased. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: valava(n)ch kar udar bharahi moorakh gaavaaraa ||
lines.translation: Practicing deceit, you fill your belly, you ignorant fool!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh de rahiaa har devanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Great Giver, continues to give you everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: daataar sadaa daiaal suaamee kaai manahu visaareeai ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver is always merciful. Why should we forget the Lord Master from our minds?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)ge bhaj nisa(n)ge kul samoohaa taareeai ||
lines.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, and vibrate fearlessly; all your relations shall be saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik dev mun jan bhagat naam adhaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Siddhas, the seekers, the demi-gods, the silent sages and the devotees, all take the Naam as their support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਭਜੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sadaa bhajeeai prabh ek karanaihaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, vibrate continually upon God, the One Creator Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khot na keechaee prabh parakhanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: Do not practice deception - God is the Assayer of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੜੇ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kapat kamaavadaRe janamahi sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: Those who practice falsehood and deceit are reincarnated in the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar tinhee tariaa jinhee ek dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the One Lord, cross over the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਨਿੰਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj kaam krodh ani(n)d ni(n)daa prabh saranaaee aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, flattery and slander, they enter the Sanctuary of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal raviaa suaamee ooch agam apaaraa ||
lines.translation: The lofty, inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land and the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak tek jan kee charan kamal adhaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, He is the support of His servants; His Lotus Feet are their only sustenance. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖੁ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੜੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekh haricha(n)dauraRee asathir kichh naahee ||
lines.translation: Behold - the world is a mirage; nothing here is permanent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa ra(n)g jete se sa(n)g na jaahee ||
lines.translation: The pleasures of Maya which are here, shall not go with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sa(n)g saathee sadaa terai dinas rain samaaleeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord, your companion, is always with you; remember Him day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ek bin kachh avar naahee bhaau duteeaa jaaleeai ||
lines.translation: Without the One Lord, there is no other; burn away the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: meet joban maal sarabas prabh ek kar man maahee ||
lines.translation: Know in your mind, that the One God is your friend, youth, wealth and everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak vadabhaag paaeeai sookh sahaj samaahee ||4||4||13||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, by great good fortune, we find the Lord, and merge in peace and celestial poise. ||4||4||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੮ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 chha(n)t ghar 8 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Eighth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਤੀਖਣ ਮਦ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਅਵਧ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: kamalaa bhram bheet kamalaa bhram bheet he teekhan mad bipareet he avadh akaarath jaat ||
lines.translation: Maya is the wall of doubt - Maya is the wall of doubt. It is such a powerful and destructive intoxicant; it corrupts and wastes away one's life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਹੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੂਸਤ ਮਨ ਚੋਰ ਹੇ ਦਿਨਕਰੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahabar ban ghor gahabar ban ghor he grih moosat man chor he dinakaro anadin khaat ||
lines.translation: In the terrible, impenetrable world-forest - in the terrible, impenetrable world-forest, the thieves are plundering man's house in broad daylight; night and day, this life is being consumed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਖਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: din khaat jaat bihaat prabh bin milahu prabh karunaa pate ||
lines.translation: The days of your life are being consumed; they are passing away without God. So meet God, the Merciful Lord.
